entities.summary: Yolanda del Monte Carmelo Ramírez y Partida, known simply as Yola Ramírez, was a Mexican tennis player active in the 1950s and 1960s who was twice a singles finalist and once a women's doubles champion and mixed doubles champion at the French Open.
